id.description: The lawyers's unique identifier in the lawdbl database

legalField.description: Comma separated list of legal fields in which this lawyer practices

country.description: Address part. Absent or 'New Zealand' means the address is in New Zealand, in which case `city` is expected to be a member of the City enum. Any other value marks an overseas office, whose city the City enum cannot express.

yearsOfPractice.description: The number of years the lawyer has been practicing, based solely on the admission date

nzlsLink.description: The lawyer's NZ law society profile URL

isGraduate.description: True when the lawyer was admitted within the last 365 days (admitted on day D: a graduate through D+364). Derived solely from admissionDate at read time and never stored, so it cannot go stale. Absent when the admission date is unknown, which is not the same as false. A graduate typically has no legalField yet because they have no public profile; that is expected, not a data gap.
